paragraphs: Compassionate residential mental health care in Los Angeles offering therapy, structure, and support for lasting emotional wellness.
Manhattan Beach, Redondo Beach, Palos Verdes Estates, Lomita, Carson, Gardena, El Segundo, Torrance, Hermosa Beach
Located in the heart of the South Bay of Los Angeles, our inpatient mental health treatment center is designed to feel familiar, fostering comfort, healing, and a sense of community.

Our holistic approach integrates therapeutic programs and experiential treatments to support your whole self. Your dedicated team works one-on-one with you to uncover and address the root causes of your challenges.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Often considered disorganized or flighty, those with ADHD and learning disorders need professional support to maintain concentration.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
For some, dependence on the use of drugs or alcohol or even specific activities or behaviors can interfere with everyday life.
The compassionate clinical team at Clear Behavioral Health works with you to determine the specialized outpatient or residential services that will work best for you today and every step of the way.

At Clear Behavioral Health, we’re not just experts in treating your mental health. We’re adept at helping you navigate your insurance to facilitate treatment, accepting most major insurance and plans. Call today and let us help you through the maze.
Let us help you through the maze.
Our thoughtfully designed, in-network mental health and addiction programs are delivered affordably in a comfortable setting nearby, or online across California.

Our residential program provides 24/7 immersive care for individuals with severe or persistent mental health needs. With an average stay of 30 days, clients receive intensive psychiatric support, a safe and supportive environment, and structured daily programming to promote stability and healing.

Our Virtual IOP offers flexible, remote mental health care ideal for working adults, students, or those needing accessible support. Treatment typically includes virtual therapy for 3 hours a day, 3 days a week, over 8 to 12 weeks—providing structure and healing without disrupting daily life.

Our medically supervised detox program provides 24/7 care in a safe, supportive environment for people withdrawing from drugs or alcohol. With continuous monitoring and evidence-based safety protocols, we help manage withdrawal symptoms and prepare clients for the next step in recovery.

Our residential rehab program offers full-time, structured care for individuals recovering from substance use, either following detox or as a primary treatment. With an average stay of 30+ days, clients receive daily therapy, medical support, relapse prevention planning, and holistic services in a supportive environment.

Our Dual Diagnosis Program is designed for individuals navigating both mental health and substance use disorders. Through integrated, whole-person care that combines clinical therapy and psychiatric support, we help clients address the root causes of both conditions and build a path to lasting recovery.

Our Outpatient Rehab offers flexible addiction treatment for individuals who don’t require 24/7 residential care. With options such as Intensive Outpatient (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization (PHP), this level of support is ideal for those transitioning from inpatient care or managing recovery alongside daily responsibilities.

Our teen program provides age-appropriate care for adolescents facing emotional, behavioral, or mental health challenges who don’t require residential support. We offer IOP and PHP options, structured for teens who can live at home but need ongoing support for mental health and substance use issues. We focus on balancing school life, family support, and integrated therapy to promote healthy growth and recovery.
Clear Behavioral Health has supported the wellbeing of clients throughout Southern California for over a decade.
Convenient, affordable, immediate, and easy to obtain
Expert clinical care centered around your unique & evolving goals
Deep local support from your care team and peers, today and tomorrow

Welcome to our Los Angeles treatment center, where compassion meets comprehensive care in a warm and welcoming setting. Designed to support your healing journey, our facility features comfortable therapy rooms, spacious group areas, and newly designed wellness spaces.
At our treatment center in Los Angeles, you’ll find a safe, structured environment focused on healing and growth—where you or your loved one can feel supported and comfortable every step of the way.
Street parking is available nearby. Kindly avoid parking in the driveway.

mainEntity.name: What is residential mental health treatment in Los Angeles, CA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Residential mental health treatment in Los Angeles provides 24/7 support in a safe, home-like setting where clients receive structured therapy, clinical care, and holistic support. It’s designed for individuals who need more than outpatient care but don’t require hospitalization.

mainEntity.name: How long is a residential mental health stay in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Length of stay varies depending on each client’s needs. On average, residential treatment lasts 30–60 days, though some clients may benefit from longer care for sustained recovery.

mainEntity.name: What’s the difference between inpatient and residential mental health treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inpatient treatment is typically hospital-based, highly structured, and focused on crisis stabilization. Residential treatment is less clinical, provided in a supportive home environment, and emphasizes long-term healing through therapy, skill-building, and daily structure.

mainEntity.name: What mental health conditions do you treat at your Los Angeles location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Los Angeles residential program treats a wide range of conditions, including depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, PTSD and trauma, OCD, and co-occurring disorders.

mainEntity.name: Do your Los Angeles mental health services accept insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Clear Behavioral Health works with many major insurance providers. Our admissions team can verify your benefits and explain coverage options before treatment begins.

mainEntity.name: Is family therapy included in your residential programs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Family involvement is a core part of treatment. We provide family therapy sessions to improve communication, strengthen relationships, and support long-term recovery.
